title: Weyl modules associated to Kac-Moody Lie algebras
abstract: Weyl modules were originally defined for affine Lie algebras by Chari and Pressley in \cite{CP}. In this paper we extend the notion of Weyl modules for a Lie algebra $\mathfrak{g} \otimes A$, where $\mathfrak{g}$ is any Kac-Moody algebra and A is any finitely generated commutative associative algebra with unit over $\mathbb{C}$, and prove a tensor product decomposition theorem generalizing \cite{CP}.

cards.label: Theorem 1
cards.snippet: As a $\widetilde{\gg}$-module $$ M(\psi_1 +\psi_2, \{K_\alpha, \alpha \in \Delta^+\}) \cong M(\psi, I) \otimes M(\psi_2, J) . $$

cards.label: Lemma 2
cards.snippet: Let $I$ and $J$ be the coprime cofinite ideals of $A$. Then a) $A=I^n +J^m$, for all $n,m \in \ZZ_{\geq 1}$. b) $A/(I^n \cap J^m) \cong$ $A/I^{n} \oplus A/J^{m} .$

cards.snippet: $W(\psi_1 +\psi_2, \ I \cap J) \cong W(\psi, I) \otimes W(\psi, J)$ as $\widetilde{\gg}$-modules.

cards.label: Lemma 6
cards.snippet: $W(\psi_1, I) \otimes W(\psi_2, J)$ is a quotient of $W(\psi_1 +\psi_2, \ I \cap J)$.
